title: Android IME committed-text input through InputContract v1 and X/Wine boundary
production_code_changed_note: Additive IME extension only: ImeCharMap.kt (new), ClientImeView.kt (new), InputContract IME methods (additive), ClientDisplayHost IME integration (additive imeView/showIme/hideIme/imeCommit), Win32 probe WM_CHAR handler (additive), ClientDiagnostics charSeen/charCount fields (additive). No existing right/middle/wheel/relative or keyboard/pointer paths modified.

commands.run_ime_test: adb -s emulator-5556 shell am instrument -w -e class com.pocketrealm.o14.O14ImeTest com.pocketrealm.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner

supported_character_set.description: US-layout ASCII characters with verified XKeycode → keysym → Wine WM_CHAR paths, derived from the winlator Keyboard.java createKeyboard keysym table
supported_character_set.unsupported_examples: accented letters (à â ñ é), CJK (中文), emoji (😀) — rejected visibly, not substituted
supported_character_set.policy: Each supported character maps to an Android keycode + shift state that the existing Keyboard.onKeyEvent path translates through the X keysym table to Wine WM_CHAR. Unsupported characters are rejected with their codepoints reported; no silent substitution.

ime_observations.charCount_note: 20 from the test phrase + 2 from 'Hi' committed while IME was open + 7 from the regression keyboard 'A'/'a' and their WM_CHAR translations. All > 22 threshold.
ime_observations.releaseNote: IME open released the held W key + right-button (1 key + 1 button) deterministically.
ime_observations.staleNote: A stale-generation IME commit was rejected; rejectedStaleEventCount incremented by 1.
ime_observations.imeClosed_note: After imeClosed, isImeActive=false and releaseAll showed zero held input (neutral state).

unchanged: native realm runtime, server/database/playerbot code, AIDL, Wine runtime, winlator X-server, O13 evidence/lockfiles

ux_t06_status: PARTIALLY VERIFIED — IME committed text reaches the Win32 probe through the InputContract for the bounded US-layout character set. UX-T06 (Type a chat sentence with punctuation) is verified to the extent of the supported set: the test phrase 'Pocket Realm 123!?,.-_' commits cleanly with punctuation. Full UTF-8/Unicode chat (accented letters, CJK) is not supported and is honestly rejected, not substituted.

default touch overlay (virtual sticks / action bar, §16.7) — not implemented
Unicode/UTF-8 text beyond US-layout ASCII — rejected, not supported (codepage limitation)
